verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say stablecoin payments settle as fiat in the merchant's Stripe balance in local currency, enabled by turning on the Crypto payment method. The merchant's books therefore never hold crypto, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the onward bank-payout step and of conversion fees/rates for crypto-originated funds, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the fiat settlement.
